latestMilestone: System Edition now includes a verified authenticated package-transaction broker/client source foundation for the future Software Center and Update Center mutation path. The broker reuses the existing distribution provider, dependency resolver, repository trust checks, peer-derived Polkit authorization, durable transaction journal, guarded package executor and post-mutation health verification. Commit requests require a short-lived peer-authorization envelope bound to the recomputed exact plan digest, package identity and operation; caller-supplied Unix identity, repository URLs and command vectors are rejected. PR #15 and all three triggered exact-main contract workflows passed. This does not yet make install/remove/apply controls available in the booted System Edition: image provisioning, runtime dependency staging, native UI confirmation wiring and disposable-image mutation E2E remain pending. Roadmap therefore remains 51/65 (78.5%), and physical Live USB qualification is still open.
